chunks: Sama'ah asked him about milk being purchased while it is still in the udders.

He said: "No, unless he milks some of it for you into a small vessel, and then you say: I purchase from you this milk that is in the small vessel and what is in its udders for a specified price. If there is nothing in the udders, then it is for what is in the small vessel."

key_terms.الضُّرُوعِ: the udders of the animal in which the milk remains
key_terms.اللَّبَنِ: milk being discussed as the subject of sale
key_terms.بِثَمَنٍ مُسَمًّى: for a specified and determined price
key_terms.سُكُرُّجَةً: a small vessel into which some milk is drawn
key_terms.يُشْتَرَى: is purchased or bought in a sale transaction

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy milk while it is still in the animal's udders?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on the sale of milk before it has been drawn from the udders. It prohibits such a sale on its own, but permits it when some milk is first milked into a vessel and the sale is concluded over the known milk together with what may remain in the udders for a specified price.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3831 - Samaah asked him about purchasing milk while it is still in the udders.

Imam (as) said: "No, unless he milks some of it into a small vessel (sukurjah) for you, and then you say, 'I purchase from you this milk that is in the vessel and what is in its udders for a specified price.' If there is nothing in the udders, then the sale applies to what is in the vessel."
